query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalOwnerships ao WHERE ao.animalId IN (SELECT a.id FROM animals a WHERE a.ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%')) as buyer_ownerships,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalPhotos ap WHERE ap.animalId IN (SELECT a.id FROM animals a WHERE a.ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%')) as buyer_photos,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalMedia am WHERE am.animalId IN (SELECT a.id FROM animals a WHERE a.ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%')) as buyer_media,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM walletTransactions wt WHERE wt.ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as buyer_wallet,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM families f WHERE f.ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as buyer_families;
